readmeMarkdown:
# OAuth Scope Minimizer

A deterministic pre-tool hook plugin for **Google Antigravity** and **Gemini CLI** that intercepts AI-agent writes to `appsscript.json` (Google Workspace Add-ons) and `manifest.json` (Chrome MV3 Extensions), blocking overly broad OAuth scopes and high-risk permissions before the file is written. It enforces least-privilege by default, recommending the narrowest viable replacement for every flagged scope or permission.

## Installation

### Google Antigravity

```bash
agy plugin install ./oauth-scope-minimizer
```

Or clone from GitHub:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/daniel/oauth-scope-minimizer.git
agy plugin install ./oauth-scope-minimizer
```

### Gemini CLI

```bash
gemini extensions install ./oauth-scope-minimizer
```

Or clone from GitHub:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/daniel/oauth-scope-minimizer.git
gemini extensions install ./oauth-scope-minimizer
```

## How It Works

The plugin registers a **pre-tool hook** that fires before every `write_file`, `edit_file`, or `create_file` call. When the target file is `appsscript.json` or a Chrome MV3 `manifest.json`, the hook inspects the content for overly broad scopes or permissions and returns a `deny` decision with actionable fix instructions if any violations are found. If the file is clean, or is not a target file, the hook allows the write to proceed.

The hook **fails open** — if anything goes wrong (malformed input, unexpected error), the write is allowed.

## Rule Summary

### Workspace Add-on Rules (`appsscript.json`)

| Rule | Blocked Scope | Recommended Replacement | Rationale |
|------|--------------|------------------------|-----------|
| W1 | `googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets` | `auth/spreadsheets.currentonly` | Full Sheets access triggers OAuth verification |
| W2 | `googleapis.com/auth/documents` | `auth/documents.currentonly` | Full Docs access |
| W3 | `googleapis.com/auth/presentations` | `auth/presentations.currentonly` | Full Slides access |
| W4 | `googleapis.com/auth/forms` | `auth/forms.currentonly` | Full Forms access |
| W5 | `googleapis.com/auth/drive` | `auth/drive.file` | Full Drive access |
| W6 | `googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly` | `auth/drive.file` | Full Drive read enumeration |
| W7 | `mail.google.com/` | `auth/gmail.addons.current.message.readonly` | Full Gmail access |

### Chrome Extension Rules (`manifest.json`, MV3)

#### Host Permission Rules

| Rule | Blocked Pattern | Location | Recommended Alternative |
|------|----------------|----------|------------------------|
| C1 | `<all_urls>` | `host_permissions`, `content_scripts[].matches` | Specific origins or `activeTab` |
| C2 | `*://*/*` | `host_permissions`, `content_scripts[].matches` | Specific origin patterns |
| C3 | `http://*/*` | `host_permissions` | `https://` equivalent or specific origins |

#### High-Risk Permission Rules

| Rule | Blocked Permission | Recommended Alternative | Action |
|------|-------------------|------------------------|--------|
| C4 | `tabs` | `activeTab` | Deny |
| C5 | `webRequest` | `declarativeNetRequest` | Deny |
| C6 | `debugger` | *(remove — no alternative)* | Deny |
| C7 | `cookies` | `storage` | Deny |

#### Content Security Policy Rules

| Rule | Violation | CSP Location | Action |
|------|----------|-------------|--------|
| C8 | External `http://`/`https://` in `script-src` | `extension_pages` | Deny — **not overridable** |
| C9 | `'unsafe-eval'` in `script-src` | `extension_pages` | Deny — **not overridable** |
| C10 | External `http://`/`https://` in `script-src` | `sandbox` | Warn (allowed) |

## Allowlist Overrides

If a broad scope or permission is **legitimately required**, create a `.scope-allowlist.json` file in your project root to suppress the denial for that specific entry.

### Example `.scope-allowlist.json`

```json
{
  "appsscript.json": {
    "allowedScopes": [
      "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets"
    ],
    "justification": "This add-on bulk-processes all spreadsheets in a shared drive."
  },
  "manifest.json": {
    "allowedPermissions": ["tabs"],
    "allowedHostPermissions": ["<all_urls>"],
    "justification": "Password manager requires universal host access."
  }
}
```

- **Matching is exact string comparison** — no globs or regex.
- Only add the specific entries you need to override.
- Always include a `justification` explaining why the broad scope is necessary.
- A malformed allowlist file is ignored (treated as empty); it will never cause a denial.
- Rules **C8** and **C9** (CSP `extension_pages` violations) **cannot be overridden** — these are Chrome Web Store hard requirements.

See [`.scope-allowlist.example.json`](.scope-allowlist.example.json) for a ready-to-copy template.

## Project Layout

```
.
├── assets/
│   └── logo.svg                # Vector SVG logo badge
├── plugin.json                 # Google Antigravity plugin manifest
├── hooks.json                  # Antigravity hook configuration (PreToolUse)
├── gemini-extension.json       # Gemini CLI extension manifest (inline BeforeTool hooks)
├── rules/
│   └── AGENTS.md               # Agent instructions for least-privilege scopes
├── scripts/
│   └── scope_gate.py           # Pre-tool hook engine (stdlib Python 3)
├── skills/
│   └── oauth-scope-minimizer/  # Remediation skill
├── tests/
│   ├── payloads/               # Test payload fixtures
│   ├── expected/               # Expected test decision outputs
│   └── test_scope_gate.py      # Acceptance test runner
└── .scope-allowlist.example.json # Template for allowlist overrides
```

## Dependencies

**None.** The hook script uses only the Python 3 standard library (`json`, `sys`, `re`, `os`, `pathlib`). No `pip install` required.

Requires **Python 3.6+** (available by default on macOS, Linux, and most CI environments).
